content: Anthropic prompt-caching docs (fetched 2026-10-05): min cacheable prefix 1,024 tokens for claude-sonnet-5; 512 for Sonnet 5.5/Opus 5.5/Opus 5/Fable 5(.1)/Mythos 5(.1); 4,096 Haiku 4.5. claude-sonnet-5 (legacy, still available) allows forced tool choice; Sonnet 5.5 rejects thinking disabled (use between_tools).
